llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed classroom interaction coach with proportional data access and teacher-confirmed record writing.

dimensions.detail: Access to studentTiers and weaknessRank is sensitive educational profiling, but it is disclosed, uses aliases rather than real names, and directly supports the stated grouping and differentiated-questioning purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown and JSON artifacts only; I found no install scripts, executable code, dependency installation, remote payload retrieval, shell commands, or tool-wrapping behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions set clear boundaries: no AI point-calling, no student-name logging, no direct student evaluation, no exercise-bank writing, and adjacent requests are routed to other skills. Trigger examples are broad but remain classroom-interaction oriented.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill uses platform memory capability and writes only interactionLogs as pending teacher-confirmed entries; it includes view, correction, deletion, pause, sharing-control, and export controls, with no silent background persistence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's main behavior is coherent with classroom interaction coaching: it reads lesson goals, class profile, student tiers, and weakness summaries to suggest questioning, grouping, cold-call recovery, and post-class notes. Its temporary fallback question-chain generation is adjacent to lesson planning but disclosed and not written back as a lesson plan.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this for Chinese-language K12 teacher classroom workflows if you are comfortable sharing lesson-plan context, class profile data, de-identified student tier/weakness summaries, and teacher-confirmed classroom interaction logs. If used outside Mainland China or outside Chinese-language instruction, localize the language, curriculum assumptions, and crisis-support contacts first.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] expected: The scanner correctly flagged tension between 'does not write lesson plans' and fallback question-chain creation, plus schema access to lessonPlans/studentTiers/weaknessRank. Manual inspection shows these uses are disclosed, classroom-coaching related, and constrained to reading upstream data and writing only interactionLogs.
[SDI-4] expected: The fallback question-chain behavior is a documentation clarity issue, but it is described in SKILL.md and paired with a prompt to return to the lesson-planner; it does not create hidden persistence or modify lessonPlans.
[SQP-1] expected: The trigger phrases are broad, but they are still classroom-interaction scenarios, and the skill includes an explicit table routing lesson planning, exercises, student analysis, and homework design elsewhere.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-language and Mainland China defaults are justified by shared platform guidance stating the library is designed for Mainland China Chinese K12 use and requiring localization before deployment elsewhere.
